inputs.text: Her 2026 State of the State agenda would make gunmakers share responsibility for weapons sold in New York being converted into illegal machine guns—and adds criminal penalties without saying who would face them. Preventing violence is a serious concern, but vague penalties and shifting responsibility onto an entire industry are no substitute for holding those who break the law accountable. The public deserves to know whether this is really aimed at manufacturers or whether the burden could spread to people who obey the law.
